items.title: Vect AI – An execution-first AI system for marketing workflows
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN, I’m building Vect AI, an execution-focused AI system designed to reduce the gap between “ideas” and “things actually shipped.” While experimenting with AI tools, I noticed a pattern: most tools are good at suggesting actions, but weak at helping users finish real work. Context switching, manual steps, and fragmented workflows slow everything down. Vect AI is an attempt to solve this by focusing on: Execution-first workflows instead of prompt demos Automating repeatable marketing and growth tasks Treating AI as a system that does work, not just advice I’m building this in public and iterating based on real usage and content feedback.
For transparency, here’s what Google has currently indexed from the project: https://www.google.com/search?q=site:vect.pro Project: https://vect.pro I’d

items.title: Building an internal agent: Code-driven vs. LLM-driven workflows
items.raw_excerpt: When I started this project, I knew deep in my heart that we could get an LLM plus tool-usage to solve arbitrarily complex workflows. I still believe this is possible, but I’m no longer convinced this is actually a good solution. Some problems are just vastly simpler, cheaper, and faster to solve with software. This post talks about our approach to supporting both code and LLM-driven workflows, and why we decided it was necessary.

title_i18n.en: Building an internal agent: Code-driven vs. LLM-driven workflows
title_i18n.zh: 构建内部代理：代码驱动与LLM驱动的工作流对比
title_i18n.es: Construir un agente interno: Flujos de trabajo basados en código frente a basados en LLM

excerpt_i18n.en: When I started this project, I knew deep in my heart that we could get an LLM plus tool-usage to solve arbitrarily complex workflows. I still believe this is possible, but I’m no longer convinced this is actually a good solution. Some problems are just vastly simpler, cheaper, and faster to solve with software. This post talks about our approach to supporting both code and LLM-driven workflows, and why we decided it was necessary.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 启动这个项目时，我内心深知我们能让大语言模型结合工具使用来解决任意复杂的工作流。我依然相信这是可能的，但不再确信这确实是件好事。
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando empecé este proyecto, sabía en el fondo de mi corazón que podríamos conseguir que un LLM más el uso de herramientas resolviera flujos de trabajo arbitrariamente complejos. Sigo creyendo que es posible, pero ya no estoy convencido de que sea realmente algo bueno.

title_i18n.en: Congressman Burchett Falls for AI Deepfake in Social Media Spat with Jack White
title_i18n.zh: 国会议员伯切特在与杰克·怀特的社交媒体争执中误信AI深度伪造内容。
title_i18n.es: El congresista Burchett cae en un deepfake de IA en una disputa en redes sociales con Jack White

excerpt_i18n.en: Tennessee congressman Tim Burchett shared an AI-generated video falsely depicting musician Jack White insulting Trump supporters, leading to a heated social media exchange about misinformation and political discourse.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 田纳西州议员蒂姆·伯切特分享了一段人工智能生成的视频，虚假呈现音乐人杰克·怀特侮辱特朗普支持者的场景，引发了关于虚假信息与政治言论的社交媒体激烈讨论。
excerpt_i18n.es: El congresista de Tennessee Tim Burchett compartió un video generado por inteligencia artificial que mostraba falsamente al músico Jack White insultando a los seguidores de Trump, lo que desencadenó un acalorado intercambio en redes sociales sobre desinformación y discurso político.

items.title: Latent Signal - Curated feed for AI news
items.raw_excerpt:
I kept losing track of what was happening in AI. It's scattered across Reddit, Discord, Twitter, arXiv, GitHub, Hugging Face. Things slip through constantly. So I built Latent Signal to consolidate it for myself. It's a curated feed for AI news. Right now it's just me, but the goal is for the community to help surface what matters. Covers LLMs, image gen, video, audio, 3D, world models, tooling, and more.
The design is entirely inspired by Hacker News. Currently pulling from these sources:
- Reddit
- arXiv
- Hugging Face
- GitHub - Hacker News

items.raw_excerpt: The article examines mentions of AI in job postings for January 2026, indicating growing demand for AI skills across industries as machine learning and natural language processing become increasingly prevalent in job descriptions.

title_i18n.es: Resumen de menciones de la IA en las descripciones de puestos

excerpt_i18n.en: The article examines mentions of AI in job postings for January 2026, indicating growing demand for AI skills across industries as machine learning and natural language processing become increasingly prevalent in job descriptions.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该文章分析了2026年1月招聘信息中人工智能相关职位的提及情况，反映了AI技术在各行业就业市场中的渗透趋势。研究显示企业对AI技能的需求持续增长，相关岗位描述中频繁出现机器学习、自然语言处理等技术关键词。

items.title: HumanMark – open-source AI content detection (self-hosted, offline)
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN! I built this because existing AI detectors (GPTZero, etc.) are all cloud-based, paid, and require sending your content to third parties. HumanMark is:
- 100% self-hosted (your data never leaves your server)
- Zero dependencies (single Go binary)
- Multi-modal (text, image, audio, video)
- Free forever (MIT license) Current accuracy is ~60-75%. I'm being upfront about that. The algorithms use statistical analysis (sentence variance, vocabulary richness, AI phrase detection) rather than ML models. Looking for feedback and contributors to improve accuracy. Would love to hear what use cases you'd find this useful for. GitHub: https://github.com/vinpatel/humanmark
